_doc: Single source of truth for which context this repo runs as (meta = framework repo authoring the templates; downstream = materialised project consuming the framework). Read by factory-pr-review Phase 0 (coherence audit) and by any future consumer that needs context-aware behaviour. To extend: bump version, add keys under audit.* — never break existing keys.

lock_step_pairs.doc: Hook scripts must mirror between meta .claude/hooks/ and template tree.
Settings JSON must mirror between meta and template tree (merge-preserve in template).
Governance scripts (governance-onedit, governance-onprompt, governance-oncompact) must mirror between meta scripts/ and template scripts/ trees.

The ONE governance reader (EVOL-043): scripts/gate.py CLI + scripts/gates/*.py package — applicability resolver, law/catalog parser, budgets, retired-term ratchet, pre-edit delivery. Hooks, the snapshot generator and the parity gates all import it; the template copy is what SETUP delivers.
gates package (EVOL-043) — see the gate.py pair.
Snapshot generator (EVOL-043): lite/full profiles, delegates corpus parsing to gate.py. Twin drift = a project would receive a different law shape than meta CI tested.

CI-invoked delivery scripts (EVOL-040): template workflows invoke these in every materialised project; template source is the SETUP-delivery copy, meta copy is this repo's own. Byte-drift between them means downstream CI runs different logic than meta CI.
CI-invoked delivery script (EVOL-040) — inventory freshness, invoked by the materialised inventory-drift workflow.
Delivery script pair of check-inventory-freshness (EVOL-040) — reconciliation half of the inventory pipeline.
Security dispatcher (EVOL-040 RDR-2) — config-driven, tool-agnostic. Template is the SETUP-delivery source; meta copy is this repo's own gate. The historical meta 0-byte state was a CVP CRITICAL.

pre-push git hook (EVOL-040) — delegates its secrets lane to the security-scan dispatcher with --require-scanner (fail-closed at push preserved). Deliberate carve-out: security_scan.enabled=false passes even under --require-scanner (ratified policy opt-out ≠ infra failure; regex floor stays).
pre-commit git hook (EVOL-046) — protected-branch guard through the reader (fail-closed) + secrets on staged files. Twin drift = a project would commit under a different guard than meta tested.

Journey grammar validator (EVOL-041) — deterministic gate for user_journey.md v2 anchors (### Paso N, BDD Scenario titles, #step-N mock ids, Feels 1-5, paths, LAW-16 purity tripwire). Template is the SETUP-delivery source consumed by CODESIGN auto-approval + CVP downstream; meta copy backs the red-proving self-test in CI.

Governance Rules corpus (EVOL-040, RDR-1): stable [LAW-NN] IDs, single namespace across the pair. Universal LAW bodies byte-identical after stripping the cosmetic list ordinal. LAW-01 carries a declared per-context addendum (lines from the first '*…application:*' marker onward exempt). Context Preservation INVARIANTS 2/4/5 diverge by design (meta: framework manifest/branch-state; template: project manifest/feature-state) — governed by CLAUDE.md § What Lives Where, not part of this corpus. LAW-15 (ADP vocabulary) lives outside § Governance Rules and is verified by reference coherence, not by this pair.

Universal CLAUDE.md clauses that must be byte-identical between root CLAUDE.md (meta) and the template counterpart. Verified by check-lockstep-pairs.sh which extracts each section listed in universal_sections (content between the H2 heading and the next H2 heading or EOF) and diffs both sides. Sections with legitimate context-specific divergence (Governance Scope wording, Pre-Action Gate steps, Core Protocols table, Generation Standards manifest path, Mandatory Law #1 addendum, Triage default, INVARIANT 4 manifest path, Workflow / Hard Gates / Living Catalogs in template only) are intentionally NOT listed here — they are governed by CLAUDE.md § What Lives Where and verified during human review (factory-pr-review Phase 0 Detector 16-meta operates on whole-file lock-step pairs, not section-level here).
